Ask your assistant about RS3 Grand Exchange guide prices, daily trends, flip estimates, normal-mode hiscores and wiki pages. Prices lag the live market.

An independent Birdwell Labs project: a read-only RuneScape 3 helper for chat. Look up items by name, compare Grand Exchange guide prices, summarize 7–90 days of price history, estimate flip profit after the 2% seller tax, check normal-mode player hiscores, and find RuneScape Wiki source links. Wiki text is available only for reviewed revisions; unreviewed pages return links without copied text. Connect the hosted MCP endpoint without an account, API key or local installation. Prices come from Jagex guide data and Weirdgloop daily history; they lag the live market. RS3 only: Old School RuneScape, live bid/ask quotes, automated trading, and ironman/hardcore hiscores are not supported. Unofficial and unaffiliated with Jagex or the RuneScape Wiki; no Jagex or Weird Gloop approval is claimed. It does not connect to the game client, request Jagex credentials or place trades. Tool results are provided to your AI client under that provider's own data-handling terms. Privacy: https://birdwellabs.com/privacy. Support and rights concerns: support@birdwellabs.com.

What data can I access with the RuneScape Wiki API tool?

RS3 item lookup, Grand Exchange guide prices, daily price history, flip estimates, normal-mode hiscores and wiki source references. Unreviewed pages return links without article text. Sources include Jagex, Weirdgloop and the RuneScape Wiki. Prices lag the live market; live bid/ask quotes and 5-minute or 1-hour feeds are not provided.
Does it support different RuneScape 3 game modes?
Normal-mode RS3 hiscores are supported. Ironman and hardcore hiscores are currently unsupported because the upstream endpoints return errors. Old School RuneScape is not supported.
Can I get historical Grand Exchange prices?

Yes. summarize_price_history returns a compact 7–90 day summary from Weirdgloop daily samples. get_item_graph exposes Jagex’s historical graph. Coverage depends on the upstream data available for that item; these are not intraday price feeds.
How do I connect, and can it trade for me?

Connect https://runescape-wiki-mcp.fly.dev/mcp using Streamable HTTP and no authentication. No game login, API key or local installation is needed. All tools are read-only: they cannot place offers or execute trades. Flip calculations are estimates, not guaranteed profit.
